messages:
Ava (AE): Heads-up handoff for Greenfield Labs 44b
Ava (AE): Quick context: annual Dedicated contract signed, primary deliverable = stable nightly embeddings pipeline + chat responsiveness for support UI. ARR $120k, renewal ~11 months.
Ava (AE): They've been testing on hosted and hit intermittent failures on large embedding jobs (timeouts and partial results). They also requested guidance on quantized models for cost savings.
Ava (AE): Main ask: CS to own onboarding + adoption; Eng/Support to investigate batch failure mode and propose short-term mitigation.

Sam (CSM): I9m taking CSM ownership. Plan: 1) Kickoff + ops deep-dive Wed 10am PT, 2) Two-week adoption sprint, 3) Collect prompt sets & evals for quality.

Priya (CS Ops): I'll assemble an "onboarding ops checklist" (SSO steps, Dedicated sizing, batching patterns, retry/backoff best-practices). Will include a cost slide comparing hosted vs Dedicated for projected monthly tokens.

Lina (Support): Need a failing job sample and client logs. Also confirm whether they used parallel workers or single-process uploader; those change tail behavior.

Ava (AE): Mark (ML infra) sent this summary (sanitized):
```
Batch job summary:
- items: 120000
- per-item size: ~1.2KB
- client concurrency: 12 workers
- chunk_size: 256
- timeout: 240s
- observed: ~25% requests returned partial payloads / 504s near job end
```
Ava (AE): They ran this against hosted; considering Dedicated to reduce interference.

Jordan (Eng): @Lina I9ll pick this up. First steps: reproduce with our batch harness, then compare p95/p99 latency distributions. Ask Mark for a sanitized sample or representative histogram. Possible mitigations: smaller chunk_size, adaptive concurrency, prefix KV caching for repeated items.

Jordan (Eng): Run suggestion:
```
./batch_harness --endpoint https://staging.redwood.ai --model embed-large --items 120000 --concurrency 8 --chunk 256
```

Devon (SE): SSO note: their IdP metadata was uploaded but attribute mapping (email vs sub) not confirmed. I9ll send a short checklist to Mark and join kickoff to verify SSO flows. For Dedicated sizing, recommend starting with 2 nodes (A10g-equivalent) and a canary traffic shape for 48 hours.

Lina (Support): Opening a ticket and tagging eng-support. ops-bot: create incident for Greenfield batch failures -> INC-2040
ops-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.ai/t/INC-2040 (assigned to eng-support)

Sam (CSM): Owners & next steps (summary):
- Sam (CSM): Run kickoff and adoption plan (owner) 4c5 kickoff Wed 2034570300
- Jordan (Eng) & Lina (Support): reproduce and root-cause INC-2040, propose short-term mitigation (owner) 4e6 initial report by 2034570600
- Devon (SE): SSO attribute mapping doc + DM to Mark (owner) due 2034570100
- Priya (CS Ops): Ops checklist + cost comparison slide due 2034570800
- Sam: Feedback capture plan (post-kickoff NPS + prompt collection) due 2034572000

Sam (CSM): Success metrics: nightly batch success >= 98% within 2 weeks, increase active users from 2 -> 8 in first month, SSO working without manual fixes.

Jordan (Eng): If we can9t repro with harness, request sanitized client trace (timestamps, response codes) and a sample compressed payload.

Ava (AE): Priya, client asked for a quick cost/latency comparison for Dedicated vs hosted at expected load. I9ll forward their token estimate after kickoff.

Priya (CS Ops): Will include both unit-cost and an example monthly runbook cost (with burst allowance).

Lina (Support): Once INC-2040 is created I9ll link logs and initial attempts here. Please drop any test payloads to the ticket.

Sam (CSM): I9ll post weekly health updates to this thread after kickoff. Tag me if you want included in the weekly summary distribution list.

Ava (AE): Thanks all 44d handoff complete from Sales side.
